description: This Figshare release harmonises annual DMSP and VIIRS nighttime-light images into a global 30-arcsecond series. Its current v10 metadata names coverage from 1992 through 2024 and lists 34 annual GeoTIFF files. The Scientific Data paper described an earlier v2 release ending in 2018, so a modeller should retain the precise version used in a study. Light intensity can act as a proxy for settlement, activity or electricity demand when building regional exposure and service-demand scenarios. It is not a direct meter reading or a full census of people. Low-intensity pixels and the sensor transition remain sources of uncertainty. The own Figshare item states CC BY 4.0 and provides file-level metadata; I did not download or compare the rasters. Related direct load measurements should be used when calibrating energy demand. No exact catalogue coverage was found.
